elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 expressly states that “Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.”

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 states that Customer “pays only for usage or Services ordered under an Order Form.”

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The rendered language eliminates any commitment rather than creating a commitment limited to the current 12-month term.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: No 30-day reduction right is stated; instead, the rendered language provides that no minimum commitment exists.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no shortfall or true-up mechanism because it eliminates the minimum commitment entirely.
